title: Bitcoin Price Forecast: BTC/USD 12.5% Plunge Nears Critical Support
content:
A closer look at the Bitcoin daily chart shows BTC/USD trading within the confines of a proposed descending pitchfork with price testing the lower parallel today. This slope converges on key support over the next few days at the 2025 low close and the 38.2% retracement at 76,159/66. The 2025 swing low rests just lower at 74,434- losses surpassing this level would threaten another bout of accelerated losses towards the 200-day moving average (currently ~73,116). The next major technical [...] Bitcoin has come under renewed selling pressure, falling below $80,000 as a hawkish Fed outlook, weakness in technology shares and a reported $6.3 billion security breach at Binance fueled risk aversion and forced liquidations. The selloff comes despite continued inflows into U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs, highlighting the growing tension between underlying institutional demand and deteriorating market sentiment. With BTC/USD now approaching a major confluence of Fibonacci and trend support, the [...] Bitcoin has fallen to six-week lows, with BTC/USD on course for a fourth consecutive weekly decline as selling pressure persists.
 The selloff is approaching a major support confluence near the lower boundary of a multi-week downtrend, raising the prospect of a potential exhaustion low.
 A sustained break below this critical pivot zone would expose the 200-day moving average and increase the risk of a deeper correction.

title: Bitcoin Price Prediction for November 2026
content:
Currently priced at $78,050, Bitcoin has seen a slight 0.7% uptick in the last 24 hours. It peaked at $86,489 on October 4 before hitting a daily low of $76,141 on October 30, when Binance, the largest cryptocurrency exchange, suspended withdrawals due to a suspected security breach. This means Bitcoin is currently trading 38.1% below its record high of $126,080 from October 6, 2025.

Concet of bitcoin stock market price going up to eleven thousand US dollars  Gold coin. [...] Bitcoin enters November at $78,050 after a 7.3% October drop, marking its second straight losing October, and sits 38.1% below its all-time high.
 Spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $643 million in outflows on October 30, their largest single-day outflow since June, dragging total net assets down to $98.1 billion.
 Binance's November 3 reserve report and MSCI's November 11 Strategy Inc. decision are two catalysts that could break Bitcoin below $76,141. [...] As November 2026 begins, Bitcoin (CRYPTO:BTC) is reeling from a challenging October, marking its second straight losing October with a 7.3% drop, following a 4% dip in October 2025. This makes any Bitcoin price prediction for November more challenging than its historically robust performance might suggest.
